snippet.title: Monkey Labour - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Monkey Labour is a great game by game development studio Dawn of Play.

Monkey Labour is our lovingly crafted riff on Nintendo Game & Watch, most specifically Donkey Kong, but with a unique gameplay.

If you have any fond memories for the handheld plastic LCD games from the 80s, you will appreciate the fact we recreated ALL the details:
* Pressing down on the LCD screen smears the liquid crystals
* Turned off sprites are slightly visible
* Simulated slow LCD response times

---

Mobot the robot is expected to mindlessly slave away at his job deep inside the bowels of a corporate production facility while his monkey boss vents frustration by throwing obstacles Mobot's way. 

Help Mobot stick it back to the system while avoiding being replaced by a cheaper model in this deliciously retro 80s style electronic handheld game rehash.

Technical characteristics:
 * AI (10 unique monkey behaviours)
 * 3D Graphics (detailed handheld device model)
 * Unique 1980s retro look & feel (sound and graphics)

---

Music by: Torul & Borut Dolenec

---
